subject: BridgeCloud — bridge plan & rebate request (MAP milestones)
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Emma Liu <emma.liu@bridgecloud.com>, procurement@bridgecloud.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: BridgeCloud: MAP & 6-month ramp — pricing proposal

Hi Emma / BridgeCloud procurement,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Attached is the updated MAP (BridgeCloud_MAP_v2.pdf) and a pricing worksheet that ties rebate milestones to a 6-month ramp. High level:
- 3-mo evaluation: access to hosted API, shared eval metrics (latency/cost)
- 6-mo commit milestone: staged commit of $185k/month run-rate (net)
- Incentive: conditional rebate applied to first 6 months if commit achieved (proposed 20% rebate applied as a rebate credit)

We can flex structure if you need a faster ramp or different payment terms — curious what your procurement needs for a formal PO and timelines. Can you confirm target decision date? Procurement mentioned June 1 in the call notes; if that’s still accurate we’ll prioritize internal approvals.

Attachments: BridgeCloud_MAP_v2.pdf (MAP, 6 pages), Pricing_Worksheet_BRIDGE-2547.xlsx (model breakout).

Next steps: if you’re comfortable, we’ll put the conditional rebate into the MAP and share a master services addendum.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[jordan.blake@redwood.com]
[Attachment: BridgeCloud_MAP_v2.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)]
[Attachment: Pricing_Worksheet_BRIDGE-2547.xlsx (XLSX, 140KB)]

From: Emma Liu <emma.liu@bridgecloud.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@bridgecloud.com
Date: 2027-05-10T12:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: BridgeCloud: MAP & 6-month ramp — pricing proposal

Jordan —

Thanks for putting this together and for the clarity on milestones. Procurement asked me to confirm a few things before we proceed:
1) We need a rebate closer to 25% on the first tranche — BridgeCloud is sensitive to unit economics during the pilot.
2) Our legal/procurement wants the PO issued by June 1 to hit our quarter. Can you confirm internal approval path (who signs off on >20% rebates)?
3) Can you shorten the evaluation plan so production pilot begins within 8 weeks?

If you can confirm the internal approvals and timeframe, we’ll circulate to our CFO and procurement team. Attached is our vendor information form (sent separately).

—Emma
Emma Liu
Director of AI Products | BridgeCloud
emma.liu@bridgecloud.com
[On Mon, May 10, 2027 at 09:12 AM Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com> wrote:]

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-10T13:20:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: BridgeCloud rebate request — need approvals

Team, forwarding Emma’s note — BridgeCloud is asking for 25% on first tranche and needs PO by June 1. They also want the pilot accelerated (8 weeks to prod).

Can finance confirm what range we can tolerate vs. deal economics? Laura — want to align on whether we escalate to exec sign-off or propose a counter (e.g., 18% + milestone-based ramp). I’ve attached the pricing worksheet with my suggested counter in column D.

Appreciate quick eyes — procurement timeline is tight.

Thanks,
Jordan

-----Forwarded message-----
From: Emma Liu <emma.liu@bridgecloud.com>
Date: Mon, May 10, 2027 at 12:03 PM
Subject: Re: BridgeCloud: MAP & 6-month ramp — pricing proposal
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@bridgecloud.com

[Attachment: Pricing_Worksheet_BRIDGE-2547.xlsx (annotated by Jordan)]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-11T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Fwd: BridgeCloud rebate request — finance view

Jordan / team,

Reviewed the worksheet + ARR profile. High level: 25% on the first tranche materially compresses our margins in the first 6 months and increases payback. We can approve up to 15% rebate at the levels proposed without exec signoff. Anything above 15% needs CFO approval.

Suggested response: offer a stepped rebate structure — 15% immediate rebate on month 1–3 if evaluation metrics hit (usage and latency guardrails), then an additional 7% (total 22%) applied retroactively if the 6-mo commit ($185k/mo) is achieved and payments are on agreed terms. Put the second tranche behind a clear milestone so we’re protected.

Attached: Finance_Margins_BRIDGE-2547.xlsx (breakout, sensitivity).

Ben Carter
Director, Finance | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Finance_Margins_BRIDGE-2547.xlsx (XLSX, 220KB)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-11T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Fwd: BridgeCloud rebate request — sales position

I like Ben’s stepped approach. From bookings and GTM perspective, BridgeCloud is strategic in US-east (large reference opportunity) — I’d support moving to 20% guaranteed with a backstop additional credit (2%–3%) tied to the 6-month commit being executed and payment timings. Anything >20% should be exec signoff, but I’m comfortable recommending 22% (contingent on CFO/CEO).

Laura Bennett
VP, Sales | Redwood Inference

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-12T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: RE: BridgeCloud rebate request — CFO review / exec escalation

Team,

I reviewed the finance sensitivity and Laura’s GTM notes. I can tentatively approve up to 22% total rebate structure as long as the following are contractually enforced:
- Minimum committed run-rate of $185k/month for months 4–12 (post-eval)
- Payment terms: net-30 with a 2% withholding for late payments
- Quarterly usage and quality check-ins; we withhold the second tranche if guardrails not met

I’m escalating to Vivek for final executive signoff because BridgeCloud is asking for a larger-than-normal upfront economic concession. Sending along an exec signoff request (Exec_Signoff_Request_BRIDGE-2547.pdf). Vivek — if you’re OK with the above, I recommend we accept the stepped approach: 15% up front, additional 7% retroactive on commit (22% total).

Neha Kapoor
CFO | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Exec_Signoff_Request_BRIDGE-2547.pdf (PDF, 120KB)]

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-13T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: RE: BridgeCloud rebate request — executive decision

Thanks all. I’ve reviewed the memo. Approve the stepped rebate: 15% immediate rebate during pilot, with an additional 7% retroactive credit (22% total) contingent on the committed run-rate ($185k/mo) and on-time payments. Conditions: add a 12-month minimum revenue protection clause (to ensure payback) and require quarterly ROI/usage reporting for the first year. Legal to add the clauses and finance to finalize the credit mechanics. Jordan — you have executive signoff; you can confirm to BridgeCloud and move to contract.

Vivek Kulkarni
CEO | Redwood Inference

--
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Emma Liu <emma.liu@bridgecloud.com>, procurement@bridgecloud.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-13T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: BridgeCloud: MAP & 6-month ramp — pricing proposal

Emma — quick update: Execs have approved a stepped rebate that I think maps to your ask. We will propose the following in the MAP and SOW:
- 15% rebate applied during the pilot months (months 1–3) if evaluation metrics are met
- An additional 7% retroactive credit (total 22%) applied if the 6-month committed run-rate of $185k/month is achieved and payments are on-time
- Contract will include a 12-month minimum revenue protection clause and quarterly check-ins for the first year

If that aligns, I’ll share a redline of the MAP and an MSA addendum for procurement to review so you can get the PO in by June 1.

Best,
Jordan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
